name: Ente Auth dropdown
author: meviusisback
description: Real Ente Auth desktop app as a dropdown overlay: bar lock icon plus toggle on a special workspace (the SUPER+E keybind is installed by install.sh, no code reads a keybind default). Auto-close and best-effort focus restore when a code is picked need wl-clipboard and one install.sh run. Login, E2EE sync and codes stay inside Ente Auth.

barWidget.description: Toggle the Ente Auth app dropdown (special workspace).
